changelog:
- Initial release of etsy-seller-coach: a comprehensive coaching tool for Etsy sellers at any stage, covering private-label, handmade, and digital products.
- Guides sellers through niche validation, listing optimization for Etsy SEO, profitability calculations, ad strategies, and account health diagnostics.
- Provides actionable advice on resolving Etsy policy and IP issues, shop suspensions, and scaling or exiting an Etsy business.
- Supports workflows for handmade goods, print-on-demand, digital products, and Etsy shop operations, while ensuring compliance with Etsy’s selling policies.
- Includes a thorough diagnostic checklist to assess a seller’s unique situation before offering tailored recommendations.
summary: End-to-end Etsy private-label / handmade / digital-product seller coach. Use when a seller asks for niche validation, listing SEO, ads strategy, account-qual...
